inputs.text: Daniel Rubenstein is right: calling it peace while Iran’s nuclear and missile programs remain unaddressed is wishful thinking, not security. Israel’s leaders have a duty to protect their people and preserve the nation’s security. A settlement only means something when backed by strength and resolve; otherwise, it risks putting political appearances ahead of the safety of families.
